location.zh: 菲尼克斯禁地 · 白虎

strategy_notes.zh: 依照试炼顺序挑战，战斗中的对手会连续出战。

engine_notes: Avatar HP 3000 (fighting) and 2500 (electric) are from 4399 2011-03-11. Lv105 and both four-move loadouts are the official boss forms 2513-2516 (2013 PetXMLInfo, seer_data monsters.json). Fighting then electric order is source-backed.
The original fought each avatar as a separate single-boss battle (first stage, then the strengthened second stage); the remake keeps one two-member team.
Both avatars start with an innate atk+2 (天生攻击+2, 2013 retrospective) and keep finite PP (PP有限可耗).

战虎 always moves first (强制先手: inferred by 4399 2011-03-11, stated by the 7k7k 2013-01-06 retrospective). Attacking it makes the attacker afraid for 1-2 turns; 思维干涉 has no effect on it and the player's 暗影护盾 does not protect against it.
战虎's boosts cannot be cleared, except by sure-hit skills (百科) and 盖亚's 日月皆伤 (7k7k). Guides say other clearing skills MISS; the remake blocks their clear and keeps their damage.
电虎 takes nothing from 海洋之心 or other percentage damage and is immune to statuses; 绝命火焰 still works, as its instant kill is not a status. Attacking it paralyses the attacker for 1-2 turns.

uncertain: Exact server IV/EV/nature, attack-stat scaling and guardian HP not recovered unless separately cited.

source_note: Historical order and specified effects are reconstructed from the cited period gameplay reports. Level 105 is the official map-table level; IV 31, zero EVs and hardy nature are explicit remake calibration; copied guardian skill sets are catalog-based, not certified historical boss loadouts.
